name: What tools and materials are typically needed for basic surface preparation?

mainEntity.name: What tools and materials are typically needed for basic surface preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For basic surface preparation, you'll commonly need a range of tools and materials. These include cleaning supplies like sponges, brushes, and mild detergent for washing; scrapers and wire brushes for removing loose paint; sandpaper (various grits) for sanding; spackle or wood filler for patching holes and cracks; caulk for sealing gaps; and painter's tape and drop cloths for protection. A suitable primer is also essential for most surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic surface preparation typically requires cleaning supplies, scrapers, sandpaper, spackle or filler, caulk, painter's tape, drop cloths, and a suitable primer.
